intro: Captions and background apply by default.
localOnly: Templates stay in this account’s local browser. They do not sync across devices.
empty: No saved styles yet. Save the current style from your project’s More menu.
frameNotice: Changing the canvas size leaves shots, keyframes and existing media unchanged. You may need to adjust the picture manually.
keepNotice: Script, manual timing, per-caption styles, audio, shots, photo timing and all keyframes stay unchanged. Caption and composition groups remain protected from AI changes after applying.
compositionNotice: Only a consistent, static main visual composition can be reused. Different layouts, animations or overlays are never merged by inference.
previewNotice: Sample captions without subject media. Play your project to check the actual result.
fontFailed: The font could not load. Please retry.
sample1: Make complex ideas easy to understand.
sample2: Give every sentence room to be seen.
sample3: Start sharing your point of view.
saveDescription: Save the actual caption style and background color, with optional canvas size and consistent static subject composition. Script, media, audio, credentials and task bindings are excluded.
name: Template name
renameDescription: Only the template name changes. Existing projects stay unchanged. Matching names are never overwritten.
deleteDescription: Only this style template is deleted. Projects that used it stay unchanged. This cannot be undone.
protectDescription: Captions or composition are protected. Confirmation replaces only the selected style settings. Script, per-caption overrides, timing and audio stay unchanged. Protection remains enabled.
invalidData: The template data is invalid. Your project is unchanged. Save the style again.
unsupportedVersion: This template version is not supported. Open it in a compatible version.
invalidOwner: Sign in with a valid account to use local templates.
ownerMismatch: The template or project belongs to another account. The operation has stopped.
invalidName: Use 1–60 characters without control characters for the template name.
unsupportedFont: This caption font is not registered. Choose a local font before saving or applying.
compositionUnavailable: There is no single reusable main visual, or its track is hidden or locked. Deselect composition to save or apply only captions and background.
animatedComposition: The subject uses animation or a mask and cannot safely be reused as a static composition. Deselect composition to preserve the animation.
mixedComposition: Subject layouts differ between segments. Deselect composition; distinct layouts cannot be saved or replaced as one shared layout.
protectedConfirm: Confirm replacement of the protected style settings first.
staleProject: The project changed during preparation. No template was applied. Try again with the current version.
staleTemplate: The template changed in another operation. Reload the library and try again.
missingTemplate: This template no longer exists. Reload the local library.
duplicateName: A template with this name or identifier exists. Choose a different name; the existing template will not be replaced.
libraryFull: The local library has reached its 500-template limit. Delete unused templates first.
storageUnavailable: Local storage is unavailable. Check private browsing and site storage permissions.
storageBlocked: Template storage is blocked or timed out. Close older tabs and retry.
storageFull: Local storage is full. Remove unused local data and retry.
storageFailed: Local template storage failed. Check site storage permissions and retry.
operationFailed: The style operation could not finish. Your project was not replaced. Please retry.
